sentence: The building was constructed around 1845 in the Georgian style and was substantially altered in 1886 in the Queen Anne Revival style.
quote: Constructed c. 1845 and substantially altered in 1886 according to plans by Langley & Burke, the property historically known as the Dr. James Elliot Graham House contains a remodelled Queen Anne Revival style, two-and-a-half-storey detached house-form building, which was originally designed in the Georgian style.

sentence: The property is historically known as the Dr. James Elliot Graham House and has also been home to Egerton's Restaurant, The Edge music venue, and Under 21/Covenant House.
quote: Following its long tenure as a private residence, the subject property has since the 1970s been home to a series of commercial and institutional establishments and organizations, including Egerton's Restaurant, The Edge music venue, and Under 21/Covenant House.

sentence: The property was listed on the City of Toronto's Heritage Register on March 15, 1974.
quote: The subject property at 70 Gerrard Street East was listed on the City of Toronto's Heritage Register on March 15, 1974.

sentence: Staff and a heritage consultant determined that the property has cultural heritage value and meets six of the nine provincial criteria for municipal heritage designation.
quote: Staff have independently reviewed the research and heritage evaluations prepared by the Consultant and agree with the determination that the property at 70 Gerrard Street East has cultural heritage value and meets six of the nine criteria as outlined by Ontario Regulation 9/06, the criteria prescribed for municipal designation under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act.

sentence: A property may be designated if it meets two or more of the nine provincial criteria.
quote: A property may be designated under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act, if it meets two or more of the nine criteria.

sentence: Heritage designation allows City Council to review proposed alterations or demolitions to the property and enforce heritage property standards and maintenance.
quote: Designation enables City Council to review proposed alterations or demolitions to the property and enforce heritage property standards and maintenance.

sentence: There are no financial impacts to the City resulting from the recommendations in this report.
